## Evidence model

Each row lists the files the generator scanned. A check is a small set of regular
expressions that must all match inside its file (a bare path is an existence
check). `implemented` means every check in the row passed - code that is wired,
not merely present; `partial` means some did; `missing`/`planned` mean none did.
The checks are intentionally structural (class/flag/method-name level), not
behavioural: this table says *the capability exists in the tree*, and the
unit/integration tests are what prove it works. Regenerate after touching any
listed file:

```bash
python3 scripts/ci/conformance-report.py          # rewrite this page
python3 scripts/ci/conformance-report.py --check  # CI gate: fail if stale
```
